findings.claim: The static-import guard requires a `from "...";` clause, so a side-effect static import (`import "ai";` or `import "@/lib/activeAiModel";`) — which would evaluate the provider/credential module at module load exactly as the requirement forbids — is not detected, while the positive `import("ai")` assertions still pass.
findings.reproduction: Add the line `import "ai";` under the existing `import "server-only";` in lib/promptRefinerShadowLiveAdapter.ts and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`; the "no shipped entry point imports the live adapter" test still passes even though the module now statically loads the provider SDK. Matching the module specifier alone (e.g. /(?:^|\n)\s*import\b[^;]*?["']ai["']\s*;/) fails as expected.

findings.claim: The timeout branch is only exercised with a plain `Error` carrying `name: "TimeoutError"`, but the SDK path this adapter configures rejects with a `DOMException` (node_modules/ai/dist/index.js:2875-2884 creates `new DOMException(..., "TimeoutError")` and @ai-sdk/provider-utils `handleFetchError` re-raises abort errors unchanged), and `safeErrorFacts` reads `error.name` only when `error instanceof Error` — so on any runtime where `DOMException` is not an `Error` subclass a real 15s timeout is reported as `unknown_after_dispatch` rather than `timeout`.
findings.reproduction: Add `["sdk timeout", new DOMException("Total timeout of 15000ms exceeded", "TimeoutError"), "timeout"]` to the post-dispatch error table in tests/promptRefinerShadowLiveAdapter.test.mjs and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`; the assertion documents the real SDK rejection shape. (Note the SDK's own `isAbortError` deliberately checks `error instanceof Error || error instanceof DOMException`.) Both classifications are closed and non-retrying, so this is fidelity only, not a safety gap.

verdict.nextAction: Approve: all three round-1 findings are addressed (the frozen 2,048-token allowance now has no runtime consumer outside its own test, the import guard is multiline-capable, and the scan covers js/cjs/mjs/jsx plus package.json), the isolation boundary holds by independent grep, and the two remaining nits are optional test-fidelity improvements.
